turns.message: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
turns.response:
With Getnet, you can advance your credit card sales (both full and installment payments) in two ways:

**1. Spot Advance (Pontual) via the Getnet Brasil App:**
1. Open the app and log in.
2. Tap "Serviços" (Services).
3. Select "Antecipação de Vendas" (Sales Advance).
4. Choose your registered bank account to receive the funds.
5. Read and accept the terms.
6. Simulate the advance to review amounts, card brands, and fees, then tap "Confirmar" (Confirm).
7. Review the final amount and tap "Antecipar" (Advance).
8. Enter your password.
9. Track your request status in the "Meus Pedidos" (My Orders) section.
*Note: The minimum amount for a spot advance is R$ 50,00 (https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/como-antecipar-sua-vendas-pelo-app/, 2026-11-07).*

**2. Automatic Advance (Automática):**
You can enable this feature either through the Getnet Brasil App ("Serviços" > "Antecipação Automática") (https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/como-habilitar-antecipacao-automatica-pelo-app/, 2026-11-07) or via the Minha Conta Portal ("Produtos e Serviços" > "Antecipação Automática") (https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/como-habilitar-antecipacao-automatica-pelo-portal/, 2026-11-20). You will need an administrative profile and password. Activation can take up to 48 hours (https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/como-habilitar-antecipacao-automatica-pelo-app/, 2026-11-07), and a minimum balance of R$ 50,00 is required for the automatic advance to take place (https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/como-habilitar-antecipacao-automatica-pelo-app/, 2026-11-07, https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/como-habilitar-antecipacao-automatica-pelo-portal/, 2026-11-20).
